summary: Iteration 2 verified the 4 new features. Backend: /api/files auth matrix PASS (401 no token, 200 valid JWT via ?auth=, 403 cross-user, 200 Bearer header). Previous iteration_1 pytest suite remains valid (not re-run to save credits per main-agent context). Frontend: (1) Create Persona voice selector renders 9 options (voice-alloy..voice-ash) each with a preview button; selected voice shows highlight class 'border-[#2F6BFF] bg-[#EEF3FF]'; preview triggers POST /api/voice/tts -> 200 and plays audio; save-persona-btn POSTs /api/personas with top-level voice='nova'. (2) Mobile chat at 390px: header title truncates (truncate class), mobile-conv-btn visible, drawer opens with 3 conversations + new-chat-btn, tapping another conv navigates and closes drawer. (3) Call Mode: overlay renders cleanly with 'Mendengarkan — bicara, saya kirim otomatis saat Anda berhenti' (NO 'tekan Kirim'), call-send-turn and call-hangup present. VAD mic flow not tested (headless browser has no mic).

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid="new-chat-btn" is rendered twice (desktop sidebar + mobile drawer uses same convListInner), causing Playwright strict-mode violations and ambiguous automation. Consider suffixing the drawer version (e.g., new-chat-btn-mobile) or scoping selection.

action_items: (Optional) Disambiguate duplicate data-testid="new-chat-btn" across desktop sidebar + mobile drawer to improve testability.
No functional fixes required for the 4 features under review.
critical_code_review_comments: files.py: path authorization relies on exact segment index parts[2]==uid; any future prefix change (e.g., removing 'aivora/videos/') would silently open cross-user access. Prefer validating against a known prefix pattern.
files.py: get_object exceptions are swallowed as 404; distinguishing storage-not-found from storage-provider errors would help ops.

Chat.jsx: convListInner rendered twice means two DOM nodes share the same data-testid for new-chat-btn and conv-<id>; consider rendering drawer+sidebar from separate components or namespacing testids.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (3/3 flows: persona voice, mobile drawer, call-mode overlay)
